subject: Vulnerability stewardship decision record + evidence request for BigBank SOC2
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: audits@bigbank.com
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vulnerability stewardship decision record + evidence request for BigBank SOC2

Hi Kim / Monica —

BigBank's SOC2 intake (audits@bigbank.com) has asked for a concise stewardship decision record covering our VM cadence and any SLA exceptions for their audit packet. They want: a one‑page decision note stating which teams own remediation windows, current scan cadence and proof of last three runs, and a summary attesting to CVE remediation timelines for any open critical/urgent items.

Key constraints / ask:
- Target: a single decision record (PDF/MD) + supporting artifacts (scan schedule export, remediation log) by EOD Friday for the auditor.
- We should explicitly call out any legacy components that have extended SLAs (e.g., the on‑prem Router R3 cluster) and provide compensating controls.

I started a draft stewardship note (attached) and exported the scan schedule stub (scan_schedule_q2_2025.csv). Kim, can you confirm the CVE remediation entries in the attached log and mark any outstanding items that require a formal SLA exception? Monica, please enumerate the compensating controls for R3 and the proposed timeline (45/90/180 days per severity).

I will consolidate and upload to the shared drive and send a one‑pager to audits@bigbank.com.

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Customer Security Engagements
Redwood Inference

Attachments: stewardship_decision_20250528.md (draft), scan_schedule_q2_2025.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vulnerability stewardship decision record + evidence request for BigBank SOC2

Tessa —

Thanks for the heads up. I pulled the remediation data and attached the current CVE remediation log (cve_remediation_log_202505.pdf) plus an export of the last three authenticated scans (scan_schedule_q2_2025.csv — includes timestamps and operator IDs). Quick notes:

- Critical CVEs: 2 closed within 7 days (see entries 1024/1029).
- High CVEs: majority remediated within 30 days; two outstanding high items tied to Router R3 (tickets R3-416, R3-419).
- Router R3 is on a constrained change window (maintenance policy + vendor coordination). Proposed formal SLA for R3: 90 days for high, 180 days for medium with compensating monitoring (IDS alerts + nightly integrity checks).

I've added a short decision paragraph to the stewardship draft ("R3 stewardship clause") and flagged the two R3 tickets as requiring an SLA exception. I propose we ask audits if they accept compensating controls plus a remediation milestone plan (30/60/90 days). If yes, we submit the stewardship_decision_20250528.md as final.

Attachments: cve_remediation_log_202505.pdf

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Vulnerability Management
Redwood Inference

From: audits@bigbank.com <audits@bigbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lynn Chen <lynn.chen@bigbank.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 08:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vulnerability stewardship decision record + evidence request for BigBank SOC2

Tessa / Kim / Monica —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. The auditor team reviewed the remediation log and the scan exports. A couple of follow ups before we can accept the stewardship note into the SOC2 binder:

1) For components on extended SLAs (Router R3) we need explicit evidence of compensating controls (console screenshots, IDS rule ids, monitoring retention policy).
2) For the two outstanding high CVEs (R3-416, R3-419) please provide a milestone plan with dates and an approver signature.

For the SLA exception process: we can accept a DocuSign‑backed exception request that references the stewardship note and links to the artifacts. If you can send the DocuSign envelope link by EOD Monday we can include it in the current audit bundle.

Regards,
Audit Intake Team
BigBank Financial

---
Auditor note: please include a short statement from the platform PM (Aditya Rao) confirming that remediation milestones are tracked in our backlog and that fallback capacity exists in the hosted region.

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: audits@bigbank.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2025 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vulnerability stewardship decision record + evidence request for BigBank SOC2

Audits / Lynn —

Appreciate the review. We've consolidated the requested items and uploaded an evidence bundle to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/shared/BigBank/SOC2/vm-evidence-2025

What we included:
- stewardship_decision_20250528.pdf (final) — includes the R3 stewardship clause and the decision to treat R3 high CVEs on a 90‑day remediation SLA with compensating controls.
- cve_remediation_log_202505.pdf (signed export) — shows ticket IDs and remediation owners.
- scan_schedule_q2_2025.csv — three most recent authenticated scans and operator log.
- compensating_controls_R3.md — details IDS rules, monitoring retention, and nightly integrity checks.

Action items for Redwood:
- Kimberly: generate the DocuSign exception envelope referencing stewardship_decision_20250528.pdf and send auditors the link (I created a placeholder envelope at https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-12345-EXC).
- Aditya: could you add a one‑line approval confirming backlog tracking for the two R3 tickets? Auditor requested a PM confirmation in the envelope.

If auditors confirm acceptance, we'll mark the stewardship record as "included" in the SOC2 binder and close the loop.

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Customer Security Engagements
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (all artifacts uploaded to shared drive)
